text: You have 30 days from delivery to return an item. Items must be unworn, unwashed and in their original packaging. Refunds go back to your original payment method within 5 business days of us receiving the return. Return shipping is free when the item is faulty or we sent the wrong item; otherwise it costs $4.95, deducted from your refund. Start a return from your account or by contacting support with your order number.
title: Returns and refunds

text: Standard shipping is free on orders over $75 and $6.95 otherwise, arriving in 3-5 business days. Express shipping costs $14.95 and arrives in 1-2 business days. Orders ship from our Austin, Texas warehouse, Monday to Friday. We do not deliver on weekends or public holidays.
title: Shipping and delivery

text: Tents and backpacks carry a 2-year warranty; everything else carries a 1-year warranty. The warranty covers manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship. It does not cover normal wear and tear, accidental damage or misuse. To make a claim, contact support with your order number and photos of the fault.
title: Warranty

text: Membership costs $29 per year and includes 10% off every order, free returns, and early access to sales. Membership renews automatically each year and you can cancel at any time from your account.
title: Trailhead Club membership

text: Our hiking boots run half a size small, so order half a size up from your usual size. Jackets and fleeces are true to size. Full size charts are on every product page.
title: Sizing

text: Down jackets should be machine washed on cold and tumble dried on low with clean tennis balls to restore the loft. Tents should never go in a washing machine; sponge-clean them with lukewarm water and reproof the waterproof coating once a year.
title: Product care

text: You will receive a tracking email within 24 hours of your order being dispatched. You can also track an order from your account, or with your order number and ZIP code on our tracking page.
title: Order tracking

text: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and Apple Pay. We do not offer cash on delivery. Gift cards are available from $25 to $500 and can be used online and in store.
title: Payment methods

text: Our flagship store is at 123 Congress Avenue, Austin, Texas. We also have stores in Denver and Portland. Stores are open 9am to 8pm Monday to Saturday and 11am to 6pm on Sundays.
title: Our stores

text: We will only share order details with the account holder. Before we discuss an order, we ask for the order number and the email address on the account. We never share a customer's home address or contact details with anyone else.
title: Privacy
